# Session 3 — the Toll Road

The party walked the toll road south. A goblin ambush at the second
bridge cost the rogue her best gloves.

At Greymoor they were given the duke's letter, and they argued about the
thistle. Sela Thorn served them ale and said nothing.

The goblin ambush was a test, not an attack. The goblins were paid in
ducats by the toll-keeper to see who carried the pouch.

Related: [[The Duke's Letter]], [[The Toll Road]]
